label.purpose: Short field keys and status ticks.

motion.name: ease-out-fast
motion.purpose: Default state transitions (buttons, field focus, links).

components.name: Signal Button
components.description: Primary action; flow-teal, used once per form.
components.css: .ds-btn-signal { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:44px; width:100%; padding:0 16px; border:none; border-radius:8px; background:#2dd4bf; color:#04121a; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; transition:background 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-signal:hover { background:#14b8a6; } .ds-btn-signal:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #0b0f14, 0 0 0 4px rgba(45,212,191,0.7); } .ds-btn-signal:disabled { opacity:0.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action; hairline border, used for Continue with Google.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:44px; width:100%; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid #2b3644; border-radius:8px; background:transparent; color:#e6edf3; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; transition:border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color:rgba(45,212,191,0.6); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #0b0f14, 0 0 0 4px rgba(45,212,191,0.7); }

components.name: Underline Field
components.description: Text field drawn as a canvas underline with a mono microlabel.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; } .ds-field-key { font-family:ui-monospace,monospace; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:0.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#7c8a99; } .ds-field-input { height:40px; background:transparent; border:none; border-bottom:1px solid #2b3644; color:#e6edf3; font-size:15px; transition:border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color:#7c8a99; } .ds-field-input:focus { outline:none; border-bottom-color:#2dd4bf; }

narrative.overview: TaoFlow Admin reads like instrumentation for people who run a system. A deep slate console where structure is drawn with hairline rules and negative space, and a single flow-teal signal marks what is live the way a control panel marks an armed channel. Restrained by intent: the visitor came to operate, not to be persuaded. Depth is tonal layering plus hairlines, never drop shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Deep slate canvas, dark by scene (a desk-operated internal console)
Hairline structure and generous negative space over boxes and cards
One flow-teal signal accent reserved for the live/active state
Workhorse sans for UI, mono for labels and status ticks

rules.name: The Armed-Channel Rule
rules.body: Flow Teal only marks what is live or actionable; never decoration, never a whole region. Its rarity is what makes it read as a signal.

rules.name: The Short-Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase mono is for short labels and field keys only; long all-caps passages are banned.

rules.name: The Drawn-Structure Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px hairlines and space, not cards or shadows.

dos: Do reserve Flow Teal for live/actionable elements
Do draw structure with hairlines and space; layer tone for depth
Do use mono microlabels for short field keys and status only
Do theme browser surfaces (selection, caret, placeholder, scrollbars) from the palette
Do keep AA contrast: all ink tones clear 4.5:1 on every slate surface
donts: Don't center the sign-in in a floating card on a gradient
Don't put a kicker/eyebrow label above a heading
Don't use drop shadows or ghost-card 1px-border-under-soft-shadow
Don't use a colored left-border bar on alerts, or emoji in place of drawn icons
Don't let Flow Teal spread into decoration or cover whole regions
